LanguageData.RR_Exp_Missing_RR_FieldRecorder: The shared field recorder is missing from the selected crew's actual inventories. Load it from storage; relief may also use the original crew's inventoried recorder at the saved site.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Missing_RR_SurveyTag: The shared kit needs six physical survey tags in crew inventories. Load missing tags from storage; no replacement tags are granted by dispatch.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Missing_RR_ReturnBeacon: The shared return beacon is missing from crew inventories. Locate or physically replace it before departure.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Missing_RR_SealedEvidenceCase: The shared sealed evidence case is missing from crew inventories. Load the case before departure.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_CannotCarry: This staff member cannot carry an expedition inventory.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_OverCapacity: A crew member's real gear and cargo exceed their native carrying capacity. Unload cargo or choose another carrier.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_PickupUnavailable: The item is unavailable, forbidden, reserved, unreachable, or too large for this pickup. Inspect the real item and pawn.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_InvalidCrew: Select one to three distinct, available employed staff at headquarters. They must be alive, mobile, controllable, and able to carry their gear.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_LoadPending: The selected crew already have inventory pickup orders. Let those jobs finish or cancel them before preparing another loadout.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_LoadoutUnavailable: The complete missing field kit cannot be reserved and carried from headquarters stock. Inspect available items, doors, reservations, and each selected pawn's free capacity.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_PickupPartiallyQueued: Some physical pickup orders were queued before another reservation failed. Let the accepted jobs finish, inspect inventory, and retry only the missing kit.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_AlreadyActive: An expedition is already staging, operating, or stranded. Recover that run or explicitly close it as abandoned before dispatching another.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_InvalidDestination: The saved destination or its walkable arrival/return threshold is unavailable. Crew and cargo remain on their current map.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_GatePathBlocked: The gate approach or arrival area is blocked. Clear a walkable route and free threshold cells.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_ApproachInterrupted: A crew approach was interrupted. Staff and gear remain where they physically are. Check their availability and issue dispatch or relief again.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_NotStaging: There is no expedition currently assembling at headquarters.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_NoOpenTrip: There is no open field expedition to recall.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_ReturnNeedsRescue: No mobile crew can complete this return order. Clear the route, tend injuries, or assign a mobile teammate to carry a casualty to the threshold.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_NoStrandedTrip: There is no stranded run ready for reopening, or a failed transfer first needs its explicit recovery action.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_OwnerMissing: The original gate, headquarters, or saved destination is missing. Existing crew, map, and cargo records are retained.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_ReliefLimit: A run permits one additional relief staff member. Use the same relief member for further rescue trips; the original survey crew is unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_ReturnClosed: The return opening has closed. Keep the crew and site intact and reopen the saved return route from headquarters.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_CargoUnknown: This cargo entry or declared disposition is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_ControllerFailure: Expedition control stopped after an error. The run and physical crew are retained for recovery; inspect the game log.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_TransferInterrupted: A cross-map transfer was interrupted. Crew remain on their actual map or in the saved transfer recovery holder. Use Recover interrupted transfers before reopening.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Dispatched: The crew crossed the threshold with their actual equipment. The gate clock is running.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_EmergencyRecall: Gate support failed or the normal window ended. Mobile crew are returning to the threshold. Emergency reserve permits one bounded return attempt; distant or incapacitated staff may need later recovery.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Stranded: The return window expired. Remaining crew and cargo stay at the saved site. Restore gate readiness and reopen that return route, or send the one-person relief team.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_BranchUnavailable: The branch or expedition save state does not permit this action.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_OperatorMustStay: Keep the assigned gate operator at this headquarters gate. Select other staff for the field crew.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_FinishHauling: A selected crew member is carrying an object in their hands. Finish that haul or put the item into an allowed inventory before dispatch.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Returned: The expedition's people or recovered remains are back at headquarters. Review actual cargo, unresolved stack changes, and evidence before settlement.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_NoTransferRecovery: No interrupted transfer is waiting for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_RecoveryIdLimit: This run has exhausted its saved recovery-attempt ID range. Existing crew and site remain intact.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_UnknownRun: This expedition record is not available in the current branch.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_CannotAbandon: Only a field expedition can be closed as abandoned. Cancel an initial headquarters approach through Abort staging.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_ClosureReasonRequired: Record a reason for closing this expedition. Review the people and property that will remain at their actual locations.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_Abandoned: The expedition is closed as abandoned. Its site, people, remains, equipment, evidence and records have been preserved where they actually are. A later expedition can visit the same coordinate and attempt physical recovery.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_RecoveredCrewUnavailable: Select a mobile, controllable survivor from an abandoned expedition who is physically at this active expedition's saved site. A casualty or corpse needs a carrier.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_CargoContradiction: The declaration conflicts with the observed item or quantity. Intact units cannot be declared consumed or lost; left-site units must actually remain at that site. Refresh the manifest and inspect the physical item.
LanguageData.RR_Exp_CargoNoteRequired: Add a short explanation for this cargo declaration. It is a player report, not proof of consumption or destruction.
LanguageData.RR_Event_ExpeditionResumed: Recovery planning resumed for the preserved expedition at {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Cargo_Unresolved: unresolved; inspect consumption, split or merge, destruction, or loss
LanguageData.RR_Cargo_AtSiteInContainer: at the saved site in another physical holder
LanguageData.RR_Exp_JobDefMissing: That action is unavailable because its job definition did not load. Check for a mod conflict; nothing was changed.
